author: Michael Sullivan
text: Have called Hamm out twice now for septic services since I’ve bought my house a few years back. Nice to use a local company, who have been in the business for years. Too many of these smaller companies are being bought up. Guys are always professional and friendly.

author: Sean Kyle
text: Outstanding service. John was very friendly and professional throughout the whole visit. Communication with the company was also excellent. Can’t ask for a better experience!

author: Richard Kelly
text:
Service : pumping, 1500 gallons.
Always excellent service. We have never used any other business. Easy to schedule / reschedule and they arrive as scheduled. Reminders via email and text. Never an issue.

author: Daren Wentzell
text: They came when I was at work. The check was left on the door for the driver. He text me before arrival then again when he was done. They came, pumped out my two septic tanks. It and it looked like they were never there. Clean professional and easy to use services.

author: Gail
text: There had been some adjustments made to the cover/entrance of the septic tank.  He took the time to figure it out.  He did a great job.
